text_block_list.text:
One afternoon. As I was heading toward the
trainers' office, I heard a familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――You there.
――A delivery for you.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeep……? A notice……?
I-Is this a reprimand……?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Negative―――…………

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――I have an item ――to hand over to this person.
…………Documents. ――From the committee.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Committee――……Ah! Is this the requisition form
for club activities? Um…… I-I'll take it……!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Objective 1, clear.
choice_data_list: In the middle of an errand?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ……Student council duties. ――Rudolf is occupied. Therefore――requested my assistance.

It seemed she had noticed the student council president swamped
with work and stepped in to help. Dutiful and reliable, as always.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I wish to become tangible results for my mentor――that is my purpose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In this country, Japan――to become an Uma Musume
capable of sparking a revolution. ――That is my mission.

A desire to repay the Symboli family――admirable, indeed.
……However, bearing all that weight had to be tough on her.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, and so my dad went and——whoa!
S-S-S-Sorry! Were we too loud!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Negative――documents.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
From the committee? Whew, what a relief, I thought you were mad at us――
……Ah…… A-Anyway! Thank you very much!
And so, the distribution of documents proceeded smoothly, until――

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl D
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa! ……Phew…… Carrying 3 buckets at once was a bad idea.
I gotta hurry, though――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Halt. You there.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl D
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa?! Ah……!
(Crash! ――Splash!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ……The documents remained dry.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl D
text_block_list.text:
I-……I-I-I'm so sorry!
……T-Towel, where's a towel! Getting one right now———!
choice_data_list: For now, why don't you go change?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――――Affirmative.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: …………I failed to hand over the documents.

It seemed she was far more concerned about the papers
than herself getting soaked. Once again――I couldn't help
seeing how earnest yet clumsy she really was.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Mission Accomplished――……I appreciate your cooperation.

We certainly managed to finish all our assignments safely.
However――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――?
…………What do you mean?
choice_data_list: That there were a lot of misunderstandings……

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ……――The task has been completed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Causing a misunderstanding……and disturbing the peace
in the hallway――I acknowledge and reflect upon it.
……However――aside from that――no operational issues.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Proceeding to debrief.

Even when misunderstood, she paid it no mind.
Though seeing that made me just a little concerned for her――
